== Source, printing and count verification (Story 386) ==
The Players Committee post linked in the article's Sources (WordPress post 34751) was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Schuman DS HD(v).txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card identities displayed in the table. The download's File page attributes it to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The article contains 60 constructed cards and 28 outside-deck cards. The original download contains 60 constructed entries and 28 outside-deck entries. Its unchanged SHA-256 is <code>19f60b270eef2afe2d22f982b30bb6764e310ce8f9b77fcafa32131f4ad21cfd</code>. Constructed and outside-deck XML identities were checked separately; outside-deck vehicles and starships retain their own type groups.

=== Printing choices ===
* 1x [[Darth Vader, Emperor's Enforcer (ALT) (Errata)]]: XML <nowiki>208_30^</nowiki>. The explicit image modifier is represented by the matching published ALT face.
* 1x [[I Am Your Father (V) (ALT) (Errata)]]: XML <nowiki>205_17^</nowiki>. The explicit image modifier is represented by the matching published ALT face.
* 1x [[Mustafar: Vader's Castle (ALT) (Errata 2)]]: XML <nowiki>209_50^</nowiki>. The explicit image modifier is represented by the matching published ALT face.
